name: ship

decoder_contract: gqa: per-layer cross_kt_{0..5}[b,6,128,seq]/cross_v_{0..5}[b,6,seq,128]; self-attn = com.microsoft.GroupQueryAttention, past/present [b,6,len,128]; seqlens_k[b]=past+s-1; total_seq_len[1]=past+s

inktex.name: inktex-woq-e10
inktex.input: online ink (x, y, t) → 12-dim point features
inktex.output: bare LaTeX, greedy decode, 258-token vocab (JSON key order = id)
